verdicts.title: Zeros and the functional equation of the quadrilateral zeta function
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper, we show that all real zeros of the bilateral Hurwitz zeta function $Z(s,a):=ζ(s,a) + ζ(s,1-a)$ with $1/4 \le a \le 1/2$ are on only the non-positive even integers exactly same as in the case of $(2^s-1) ζ(s)$.
